Versatility is a wonderful virtue to possess in any sphere of life. To be very good at more than one discipline is a grand trait not bestowed upon many. True, one must work unbelievably hard to maximise that gift, but as they say in a sporting parlance, primarily, you make your own luck.
Versatility can also be counter-productive, especially in a setting like a team sport. And in the context of Indian cricket, specifically.
